race.comment: D'ORO CHOICE (4) ran in a better standard BM66 in Newcastle third up and was not far away at the end. You can expect he will not contest the early stages but be finding the line strongly. They have tinkered with the gear as well so this is the big play here. GODWITS (1) keeps running very consistent races from the front but is just finding something better. He is getting closer, though. MINISTER GARRETT (8) runs off a quick backup for this. He too prefers to sit on the speed and tough it out. Will certainly be fit enough. BOLD TYRANT (7) ran his best race easily in sometime at Mudgee. This is obviously tougher but might place. COTO DE CAZA (2) has been a while between wins but the last couple have been solid enough.
